note: Colorado Parks & Wildlife, on US-50 at mile marker 260 about 20 miles west of Cañon City in the Arkansas River canyon. The campground loop is on the south side of the highway; a passageway under the bridge reaches the day-use site on the river side (watchable-wildlife exhibit, observation deck over the river, picnicking). A trail into the McIntyre Hills WSA starts between sites 4 and 5. --Claude
summary: CPW Vallie Bridge-Parkdale page + cpwshop park and 20 site pages: confirmed 20 basic sites, no hookups, vault toilets, no potable water, reservation only. Added max 71 ft (all sites 23-71 ft drive-in), 5 pull-throughs, water/sewer none, year-round season, url/window 180/fcfs never/booking season. Fees ($28) left as stored. Note: the campground is one loop south of US-50 (the north-side loop is the day-use site), so 'two loops astride the highway' was dropped; amenity/booking restatements dropped.
flags: Pin: stored 38.4521,-105.4919 is ~120 m SE of the 18 GIS-tagged sites' centroid (38.45280,-105.49298), in the scrub outside the loop. Suggest re-pinning to ~38.4528,-105.4930.
